Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
wannan bincike bai karewa hakaranar ma ance kurawa nonon mce ido yn sa a dade dunia

output.sadness: Wannan bincike bai kawo karshen batun ba, kuma an ce har yanzu ana damuwa da harkokin mata a wannan duniya ta kewa.
output.fear: Wannan bincike bai kare ba, kuma an ce akwai alamu masu tayar da hankali dangane da halin da mata ke ciki a duniya.

output.disgust: Wannan bincike bai kammala ba, an ce lamarin da ke faruwa ga nonon mata yana da matukar bayyana da kuma zafi a wannan duniya!
